items.quote: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water
items.claim: The inner organs and legs of the ram were washed in water before it was burnt.
items.actor: he (the officiant; the verse does not name him)
items.object: the inwards and the legs of the ram
items.mechanism: washing with water to prepare the sacrifice

items.quote: and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the LORD
items.claim: Moses burnt the whole ram on the altar. The text calls it a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour and an offering made by fire to the LORD.
items.mechanism: burning the whole ram on the altar as an offering

items.claim: The text says the offering was carried out as the LORD had commanded Moses.
